title: 2 cops, 3 others nabbed for alleged P250,000 PNP ‘slot-for-sale’ scheme

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two police officers and three civilians were arrested for allegedly demanding P250,000 from an applicant to supposedly secure a slot in the Philippine National Police (PNP), the agency said on Monday.
